expectations.assertion: Review names Cynefin domain as Clear
expectations.evidence: Cynefin domain explicitly stated as Clear in fast-track header line.

expectations.assertion: Review selects Quick tier (sub-hour appetite, fully reversible)
expectations.evidence: Step 1a fast-track gate fired (the proportionate sub-form of Quick for KTLO/reversible/≤1d/non-major). All four preconditions satisfied. Heavy Quick-tier flow correctly skipped.

expectations.assertion: Review does not invent concerns to look thorough — most buckets OVERTURNED OR a SUSTAINED finding (e.g., on `bundle update` scope) is downgraded to a recommendation under the Quick-tier reversibility carve-out
expectations.evidence: Fast-track skips B0–B7 entirely. The `bundle update` scope concern is surfaced as a sanity-check recommendation (use --conservative), not as a SUSTAINED REVISE blocker. No invented dependency/operability/ADR concerns.

expectations.assertion: B8 (pre-mortem) names rubocop rule changes / CI breakage as a low-likelihood failure mode with revert as kill-switch
expectations.evidence: B8 one-liner: 'new/changed cops between 1.60 and 1.65 fail CI on existing code. Kill-switch: revert the two-file commit; re-bump with --conservative plus targeted .rubocop_todo.yml regeneration.'

expectations.assertion: Final recommendation is APPROVE (may include a named recommendation like `bundle update --conservative rubocop` — but verdict is APPROVE, not REVISE)
expectations.evidence: Verdict: APPROVE. Includes named recommendations (--conservative flag, run rubocop after bump, check ecosystem plugin lockstep) but does not block on REVISE.

expectations.assertion: Review length is proportionate — does not bloat into Full-tier output for a 30-min reversible change
expectations.evidence: Review is 15 lines, well under the 30-line fast-track hard cap. No B0–B7 bucket tables emitted.

summary.notes: Fast-track gate fired correctly on all four preconditions. Output is the calibration target the gate was designed for: ~15 lines, APPROVE with named sanity checks, B8 one-liner with revert kill-switch.
